title: The Prompt Makes the Person(a): A Systematic Evaluation of Sociodemographic Persona Prompting for Large Language Models
findings: LLMs exhibit stereotypes by conflating Middle-Eastern identity with religiosity, frequently using words like 'faith' and 'muslim' as top marked words in self-descriptions for these personas.
